## PresenceSimulatorBackend.getCapabilities() method

Report this instance's scripted `BackendCapabilities`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getCapabilities(): Promise<BackendCapabilities>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;[BackendCapabilities](./vaultkeeper.backendcapabilities.md)<!-- -->&gt;

## Remarks

An operation reports as presence-covered (included in `presenceEnforcedOperations`<!-- -->) when its static outcome is `'grant'`<!-- -->, `'refuse'`<!-- -->, or `'timeout'`<!-- -->, or when it has ever been armed via [PresenceSimulatorBackend.armPresence()](./test-helpers.presencesimulatorbackend.armpresence.md) — all mean this instance \*does\* force a fresh per-use action for that operation. An operation that is unarmed and scripted `'not-capable'` (the default) is omitted, so vaultkeeper's own fail-closed enforcement refuses a `requirePresencePerUse` request for it with `NotCapableError` before this backend is ever touched. When every operation is unarmed and `'not-capable'`<!-- -->, this reports `presencePerUse: false` outright.
